name: prestashopheaven/build-external
description: The external package search on Packagist and npm (ps-module find --external) and the compatibility check of risks B1-B8 (ps-module external check): PHP range, clashes with what PrestaShop ships, scoping, license, health and size.

prestashopheaven.use-when: Before writing code that an external package might already do: search Packagist and npm, and check whether a PHP package can be used in our modules without breaking them (use through a wrapper, or write our own with the risk numbers).
